sections.title: Imports of notice parts
sections.what: Brings in the hook that holds notice state and the parts used to draw each notice.

sections.name: Toaster
sections.title: Draws the list of notices
sections.what: Reads the active notices, draws one notice box for each with its title, description, action and close button, and places them in the notice area.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond showing the notices the hook holds.
sections.watch_out: Each notice needs a unique id, which is used as its key. Without it the list can redraw incorrectly.

summary: Draws every active notice by reading the notice list and placing each one in the notice area.
purpose: Shows the pop-up messages the rest of the app triggers, each with its title, description, optional action and close button.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It is the one component that connects the notice list to the screen.
how: Reads the current list of notices from the hook. Provides the notice area. For each notice, draws a Toast with its title and description if present, the action if present, and a close button. Adds the viewport last.
inputs: The list of notices from useToast, each with an id and optional title, description and action.
risks: Its output is only as correct as the list it reads. A wrong list gives wrong notices.
debug: If nothing appears, check that Toaster is mounted once in the app and that toast() is being called. If notices stack oddly, check TOAST_LIMIT in use-toast.
